entries.desc: A saved scope contract can be read back with all fields preserved.
Missing optional arrays default to empty arrays and do not crash show/check commands.
Invalid mode or malformed path entries are rejected before persistence.
scope_contract_set/show/check CLI commands exist and return structured output for an in-scope diff.
scope_contract_check handles a clean worktree and reports no changed files without failing.
scope_contract_check returns fail with violating paths when git diff includes protected or excluded files.
A story with an enforce contract and only allowed changed files can advance through the scope gate.
Stories without a contract stay backward-compatible unless strict policy explicitly requires one.
An enforce-mode contract blocks REVIEW/TEST/DONE when the diff contains a protected or excluded path.
An explicit scope change acknowledgement records actor, reason, timestamp, and added paths.
A scope acknowledgement with an empty or too-short reason is rejected.
Acknowledgement cannot silently hide an out-of-scope diff; reviewer-visible output still lists the expanded paths.
The smoke test passes for allowed changed files and clean worktree cases.
The smoke test proves shadow mode warns without blocking and missing contracts stay compatible where intended.
The smoke test proves enforce mode fails for protected/excluded files and requires explicit acknowledgement for expansion.
